meta.name: prd-securability-enhancement
meta.description: Enhance PRDs, feature specs, user stories, or product briefs with explicit OWASP ASVS coverage and FIASSE v1.0.4 SSEM implementation guidance — before code is written. Trigger on "harden the PRD/spec", "choose ASVS level", "map features to ASVS", "find missing security requirements", "add NFRs for security", "make these requirements securable", "security-review my product brief". For code review use securability-engineering-review; for code generation use securability-engineering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在写产品文档前嵌入安全需求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责产品文档并希望提前考虑安全要求
copy.tagline_en: Embed security requirements into product documents before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write product specs and want to include security requirements early

howto.what: Claude 会分析你的产品需求文档，为每个功能补充 OWASP ASVS 安全要求和 FIASSE/SSEM 实施指导，并生成可测试的验收标准。
howto.when: 当你要求“加固 PRD/规格”、“选择 ASVS 级别”、“将功能映射到 ASVS”、“查找缺失的安全需求”、“添加安全 NFR”或“安全审查我的产品简介”时触发。

say.text: 帮我加固这份 PRD，添加安全需求。
say.note: Claude 会解析文档并生成 ASVS 覆盖矩阵。

say.text: 为这个功能选择 ASVS 级别并映射到 V2 和 V4。
say.note: Claude 会推荐级别并列出对应需求。

say.text: 检查我的用户故事中缺失的安全验收标准。
say.note: Claude 会识别缺失项并补充可测试条件。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your PRD, adds OWASP ASVS security requirements and FIASSE/SSEM implementation guidance for each feature, and generates testable acceptance criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "harden the PRD/spec", "choose ASVS level", "map features to ASVS", "find missing security requirements", "add NFRs for security", or "security-review my product brief".

say_en.text: Harden this PRD with security requirements.
say_en.note: Claude parses the doc and produces an ASVS coverage matrix.

say_en.text: Choose an ASVS level for this feature and map to V2 and V4.
say_en.note: Claude recommends a level and lists applicable requirements.

say_en.text: Check my user stories for missing security acceptance criteria.
say_en.note: Claude identifies gaps and adds testable criteria.
